Reunion in a New Land]]'' }} |} '''Peonia''' (Japanese: '''シャクヤ''' ''Shakuya''), commonly referred to as '''Nia''' (Japanese: '''シャクちゃん''' ''Shaku-chan'') by her father [[Peony]], is a character in [[The Crown Tundra]] in {{g|Sword and Shield}}. ==In the core series games== Peonia first met in front of the [[Slippery Slope|Crown Tundra Station]], arguing with [[Peony]]. Spotting the {{player}}, she asks them to {{pkmn|battle}} her father. Regardless whether the player wins of loses, Peonia escapes to the [[Max Lair]] during the battle. Once the player has completed their first [[Dynamax Adventure]], Peonia appears before them and asks for them to take her place in her father's adventures around the [[Crown Tundra]]. Once the player has completed all of Peony's adventures, Peonia appears in [[Freezington]], ready for an adventure with her father. Peony hastily promises to invent some new legends to explore, which ends up offending Peonia and causes her to return to the Max Lair. Peonia is mostly found at the Max Lair entrance, where she can be talked to. Sometimes, she will gift the player with clothing items or offer to teach them a path to a special Pokémon in the Max Lair in exchange for some [[Dynite Ore]]. ===Pokémon=== =====[[Max Raid Battle]] partner===== Peonia can occasionally appear as a partner to assist the player in Max Raid Battles in the Crown Tundra. text-align:center; border:3px solid #{{steel color dark}}; background:#{{cuteness color}}; font-size:80%; border-radius: 10px" |- | style="border:2px solid #{{cuteness color light}}; background:#{{cuteness color light}}" | [[File:PeoniaChillingReign149.jpg|x250px]] |- | {{color2|000|Chilling Reign (TCG)|Chilling Reign}} artwork of Peonia by {{color2|000|kirisAki}} |} ==Quotes== {{main|Peonia/Quotes}} ==In animation== ===Pokémon: Twilight Wings=== Peonia appeared in ''[[TW08|The Gathering of Stars]]'' where she was seen walking off in a train headed for the [[Crown Tundra]], asking her father [[Peony]] to stop chasing after her. ==In the manga== [[File:Peonia Adventures.png|thumb|150px|Peonia in [[Pokémon Adventures]]]] ===Pokémon Adventures=== Peonia debuted in ''[[PASS32|Boom!! Reunion in a New Land]]''. She traveled to the [[Crown Tundra]] hoping to try out [[Dynamax Adventure]]s, only for her overbearing father [[Peony]] to demand they participate in a father-daughter tour of the area. While on a train, Peonia encountered [[Hop]], [[Bede]], and [[Marnie]], whom she asked keep her hidden. They agreed, but upon noticing Peony's resemblance to [[Rose]], Bede's dedication to the chairman led him to exposing Peonia. Later, Peony agreed to a battle with Marnie with Peonia's freedom on the line. Marnie eventually won, allowing Peonia to leave and challenge the [[Max Lair]]. In ''[[PASS38|Munch Munch!! The Mysterious Carrot]]'', Peonia returned and agreed to join Peony, Bede, and {{Henry}} on the adven-tours, much to her father's delight. Later that night, a horrified Peonia found her father's body suddenly floating in the air. Bede explained that Peony was possessed by {{gal|Calyrex}}, the King of Bountiful Harvests, so that it could communicate with humans. Peonia, Henry, and Bede agreed to help restore Calyrex to its former glory in order to obtain the missing [[Rusted Sword]]. Together, the group tried reuniting Calyrex with its former loyal steed, {{p|Spectrier}}. With the [[Black Mane Hair]] collected from Spectrier and the [[Radiant Petal]] Calyrex made, Henry forged the [[Reins of Unity]]. In ''[[PASS40|Rumble!! The Darkest Day Returns]]'', Peonia and the others lured Spectrier to the [[Crown Shrine]], but they were interrupted by a [[Gigantamax]]ed {{p|Corviknight}} and {{p|Butterfree}}. Realizing the [[Darkest Day]] had restarted, Peonia, Bede, Henry, and Peony fought off the rampaging giants. With the reins, Calyrex reforged its bond with Spectrier and changed into its {{form|Calyrex|Shadow Rider}} form, allowing it to find and retrieve the Rusted Sword. Later, Peonia and Calyrex said their farewells to Henry and Bede as they returned to the Galar mainland. {{-}} ====Pokémon==== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Peonia |pkmn=Tyrantrum |type1=Rock |type2=Dragon |img=Peonia Tyrantrum Adventures.png |img_size=120px |epnum=PASS40 |epname=Rumble!! The Darkest Day Returns |desc={{p|Tyrantrum}} is Peonia's only known Pokémon. It was used to battle a wild [[Gigantamax]] {{p|Corviknight}} and {{p|Butterfree}} at the [[Crown Shrine]]. None of Tyrantrum's moves are known.}} ==In the TCG== [[File:PeoniaChillingReign196.jpg|200px|thumb|Full Art print of Peonia]] {{main|Peonia (Chilling Reign 149)}} '''Peonia''' was introduced as a {{TCG|Supporter card}} in the [[Pokémon Trading Card Game]] during the English Sword & Shield Series (the Japanese Sword & Shield Era). It was first released in the Japanese {{TCG|Jet-Black Spirit}} expansion before debuting in English in the {{TCG|Chilling Reign}} expansion, with artwork by [[kirisAki]]. It was also released as a {{TCG|Full Art card}} and {{TCG|Secret card}} in the same Japanese and English expansions, with artwork by the same artist.
